title: Gumroad API: setup guide · verapli
snippet:
REST API (v2) for a Gumroad creator account. Create an application under Settings > Advanced; for your own account, generate a personal access token there instead of running OAuth. Gumroad is the merchant of record for sales.

- **Gumroad account** personal owned by the creator (person or business)
- **API application** developer · under Gumroad accountNeeded both for OAuth (third-party users) and to generate a personal access token.

title: Gumroad - free API
snippet:
Gumroad is a platform for selling digital products, and its free API lets developers verify software license keys, fetch product and sale data, and manage resources programmatically. Any free Gumroad account can generate an API token from Settings, Advanced, and there is no monthly cost to use the API. The license verification endpoint is the most popular, letting desktop and web apps check that a customer's key is valid. Gumroad takes a transaction fee on sales, but the API itself is free.

### Get free access
Open the provider's signup page and make a free account.
[Sign up for Gumroad ↗](https://gumroad.com)

**Access**Free key (no card)
**Rate limit**Gumroad publishes no fixed API quota; avoid polling and use webhooks for sale notifications instead.
